text:
[2674]
SNOD KYI ‘JIG RTEN SHIN TU SNA TSOGS PA NI SEMS CAN DE DAG KHO NA’I SEMS NYID KYIS BSAGS PA’I THUN MONG BA’I LAS KYIS ‘GOD PA STE SKYED DE, RLUNG GI DKYIL ‘KHOR NAS ‘OG MIN GYI SNOD KYI MTHAR THUG PA’O,,

And the vessel of the outer world, with all its endless variation, is something that has been “set forth”—which is to say, created—only by all these living beings, through the communal karma they have accumulated with nothing other than their own minds.  And this refers to the entire universe, up to its very ends—starting from the disk of wind that serves as the foundation of the universe, up to the highest of its levels, known as “Below None.”


[2675]
DE LA RMA BYA LA SOGS PA’I MDONGS LA SOGS PA SNA TSOGS PA NI, SEMS CAN DE RNAMS KHO NA’I LAS THUN MONG MA YIN PAS SKYED PA’O,,

And so things like the extraordinary variety of colors found in things such as the feathers of the peacock are all objects which were created by the unique karma only of living beings themselves.


[2676]
PAD+MA LA SOGS PA’I ‘DAB MA DANG KHA DOG SNA TSOGS PA NI, SEMS CAN GYI THUN MONG GI LAS KYIS BSKYED PA’O,,

The petals and multifarious hues of things like the lotus too are produced from the shared karma of living beings.


[2677]
DE BZHIN DU GZHAN LA’ANG SHES PAR BYA’O,,

And you can understand everything else there is, as being similar.


[2678]
JI SKAD DU,
,SEMS CAN LAS KYI DBANG GIS RI,
,NAG PO’I DUS SU SKYES TE DPER,
,SEMS DMYAL MTHO RIS ‘JIG RTEN DU,
,MTSON DANG RIN CHEN SHING BZHIN NO,
ZHES GSUNGS SO,,

In the days of darkness,
The mountains rose up
Due to the power
Of the karma of beings.

It was just the same
As how weapons
And trees made of jewel
Appear in the realms
Of hell and the higher births.


[2679]
‘JIG RTEN GNYIS THUN MONG GI LAS YIN MIN GNYIS KYIS BSKYED PA NI, SEMS TZAM [f. 192b] GYI GZHUNG DU YANG BSHAD PAS SEMS TZAM GYI LUGS LA’ANG SNOD KYI ‘JIG RTEN MED PA MIN NO,,

The idea of two different worlds created by karma of beings which is either shared or not is something that we also observe in the great books of the Mind Only school; as such, we can say that it is not the case that in the Mind Only system there is no vessel of the outer world.


[2680]
DE LTAR NA ‘GRO BA MA LUS PA LAS LAS SKYES PAR GSUNGS SHING, SEMS SPANGS NAS NI LAS KYANG YOD PA MA YIN TE SEMS DANG BCAS PA KHO NAS LAS GSOG PA’I PHYIR NA LAS KYANG SEMS LA BRTEN PA’O,,

Thus it is then that it was stated that all the beings there are have been created by karma; and that—if we were to eliminate the mind—then there would no longer be any karma either.  That is, it being the case that karma is collected only by those who possess a mind, we can say that karma too is something that depends upon the mind.


[2681]
DE LTAR NA SA BCU PAR BYED PA PO DANG TSOR BA PO MED PA ZHES GSUNGS PA LA BRTEN NAS, TZAM GYI SGRAS BYED PA PO GZHAN ‘GOG PAR BSTAN LA, 

We can say then that—based on the statement in The Ten Levels that there is no creator, and no one who has feelings—the term “only” is meant to deny any other creator of things.


[2682]
YAN LAG BCU GNYIS PO THAMS CAD KYANG SEMS GCIG LA BRTEN PAR GSUNGS PA LA BRTEN NAS, TZAM GYI SGRAS SEMS GTZO BOR GYUR PAR BSTAN TE, BSHAD PA SNGA MA DGAG PHYOGS DANG PHYI MA SGRUB PHYOGS NAS YIN NO,,

And so we see statements that all of the twelve links of dependence rely on but one thing, the mind.  Relying on these statements, we can say then that the word “only” is meant to indicate that it is the mind which is primary.  The former of the two statements is made from the negative side of things; while the latter is meant from the positive side of things.


[2683]
DE’I PHYIR ‘GRO BA RAB TU ‘JUG PA LA SEMS NYID GTZO BO’I RGYU YIN GYI, SEMS LAS GZHAN PA NI GTZO BO’I RGYU MIN PAS, MDO LAS SEMS TZAM ZHIG GTZO BOR BZHAG GI GZUGS NI MA YIN NO,,

And so for the concerns of living beings, the mind is the principal cause; but things which are other than the mind are not the main cause of things; as such, what sutra is saying is that it is “only the mind” which is the main thing, and not physical matter.


	[2684]
[VI.90]
Rūpam asti khalu yadyapi tasya
